M–Y Confounding Sensitivity for the Incremental Mediated Elasticity

Source: R/incremental-sensitivity.R
incr_sensitivity.Rd

Per-delta M–Y unmeasured-confounding sensitivity for an IncrPmedResult. For each tilt factor delta, reports the additive numerator bias that zeroes the incremental mediated share (tipping) and, optionally, the bias that drives P_med^delta to a user threshold. Reuses pmed_sensitivity(); the additive-offset model is exact for the Paper 2 (mean-based) share.

Usage

incr_sensitivity(object, threshold = 0, ...)

Arguments

object

An IncrPmedResult from incr_pmed().

threshold

Numeric or NA: a P_med value whose tipping bias to report per delta (default 0 = "bias that makes the share vanish").

...

Unused.

Value

A data frame: one row per delta with columns delta, med, tot, Pmed, tipping, tipping_threshold.

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 800; C <- rnorm(n)
A <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(-0.2 + 0.8 * C))
M <- 0.6 * A + 0.4 * C + rnorm(n)
Y <- 0.5 * A + 0.7 * M + 0.3 * C + rnorm(n)
fit <- incr_pmed(data.frame(A, M, Y, C), deltas = c(0.5, 1, 2))
incr_sensitivity(fit, threshold = 0)
#>   delta        med       tot      Pmed     tipping tipping_threshold
#> 1   0.5 0.16221922 0.3872558 0.4188943 -0.16221922       -0.16221922
#> 2   1.0 0.09485621 0.2289208 0.4143626 -0.09485621       -0.09485621
#> 3   2.0 0.04693414 0.1132813 0.4143150 -0.04693414       -0.04693414
